coordinate_system: Unrotated PDF user-space points; retain MediaBox/CropBox/page rotation; page_index is zero-based and UI page_number is index+1

access.default: Browser session cookie (X-CSRF-Token header on POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) or X-RAG-Control-Token header

commands.open: launcher command of this host: .\rag.ps1 open on Windows, ./rag.sh open on Linux

generation.fallback: boolean: true once a GPU load failure has switched the instance to CPU until restart (W025)
generation.processor: string|null: placement of the model last read by the API in Ollama /api/ps, as the PROCESSOR column of ollama ps (100% GPU, 100% CPU, <cpu>%/<gpu>% CPU/GPU or Unknown); read before each question and, in gpu mode, after each answer, never by GET /jobs itself; null until the model has been seen loaded since the API started, and again after a GPU fallback, which unloads it
generation.null: when the API runs with a test double of the Ollama gateway

page.label: string|null
page.media_box: [x0,y0,x1,y1] or null when inherited box unavailable

reindex_response.version_id: uuid, absent when a queued, extracting or indexing job of the document is returned (reused true)
reindex_response.job_state: paused, only when the last job of the latest version is paused and returned instead of a new job; outcome of every last job state in reindex_outcomes
reindex_response.resume_required: true with job_state: resume that job (POST /jobs/{job_id}/resume) instead of starting a second extraction

queued|extracting|indexing.rule: a job of the document is in progress: it is returned and no job is created

paused.rule: the paused job of the latest version is returned, to resume, instead of a second extraction

error.message: string: wait for the pause to complete, then resume that job from the Suivi view

pausing.rule: the job cannot be resumed yet (POST /jobs/{job_id}/resume answers 409 job_not_resumable): the request is refused and no job is created

cancelling|cancelled|error|ready|ready_p.rule: a new queued job is created on the latest version; while cancelling, the cancellation stays final and the queue, which runs one job at a time, starts the new job after it

imports.job_id: uuid: the queued job created for a new path or new content (new version), or, when identical content was already imported at the same path, the job given by import_outcomes
imports.job_state: paused|pausing, only when the last job of the identical version is suspended and returned instead of a new job; outcome of every last job state in import_outcomes
imports.resume_required: true with job_state paused only: resume that job (POST /jobs/{job_id}/resume) instead of starting a second extraction

import_response.document_id|version_id|job_id|reused|job: with a single file only: the fields of imports[0], repeated at the top level

queued|extracting|indexing|ready|ready_p.rule: identical content already imported at the same path: its last job is returned and no job is created

paused.rule: the paused job is returned, to resume, instead of a second extraction

pausing.rule: the job cannot be resumed yet (POST /jobs/{job_id}/resume answers 409 job_not_resumable): it is returned with job_state pausing, without resume_required, and no job is created; the other files of the request are imported (reindex refuses this state with 409 job_pausing)

cancelling|cancelled|error.rule: a new queued job is created on the identical version; while cancelling, the cancellation stays final and the queue, which runs one job at a time, starts the new job after it

query_created_response.state: needs_clarification, only when the follow-up referent is ambiguous

llm_execution.fallback: boolean: true when this answer was regenerated on CPU after a GPU load failure of the same request (W025)
llm_execution.rule: present only when the model was called (model_called true), absent from the done of an abstention; mode is the execution mode requested from Ollama for this answer (num_gpu omitted in gpu mode, num_gpu: 0 in cpu mode), not the observed placement of the model, which jobs_response.generation.processor and doctor report

fallback.error: Ollama error message, at most 300 characters, never the prompt
fallback.null: until a GPU load failure; afterwards mode is cpu until restart and reason keeps the startup decision

diagnostics_llm_accelerator.rule: published only by GET /diagnostics, never by a public route; with a cpu profile, reason is imposed_by_profile or legacy_profile_cpu (legacy llm.num_gpu: 0), with or without the supervisor decision; reason is null for an auto or gpu profile started without the supervisor decision (RAG_LLM_ACCELERATOR), or when the transmitted reason is unknown or contradicts the mode

ingestion_boundary: services.ingestion exposes preflight_pdf(path, config=None), extraction_fingerprint(config=None), extract_window(path, version_id, page_start, page_end, config, output_dir, cancel_event=None) and extract_pdf(path, output_dir, config, version_id, cancel_path=None) without importing Docling. The API runs the extraction in a separate process, python -m services.ingestion.worker --request worker-request.json --result worker-result.json, with an environment stripped of the instance secrets (RAG_CONTROL_TOKEN, RAG_QDRANT_API_KEY). Return serializable window_extraction documents and extraction.json. Backend owns chunking with true E5 tokenizer and SQLite publication; ingestion never imports backend stores or Qdrant handles.
governor_boundary: services.runtime.resources.ResourceGovernor(settings=None, host_lock_path=None) is built by services.api.main.create_app with the loaded profile (app.data_dir resolved) and runtime_location(profile, 'host_lock_path'), or injected into create_app(governor=...). It exposes snapshot(), begin_interactive(), finish_interactive(), should_checkpoint(), allow_ingestion(), resume_ingestion(), request_ingestion_pause(), the async context managers ingestion() and generation(on_wait=None), and readmit_generation(loaded=None), a new admission inside the current generation lease that the API awaits before regenerating on CPU after a GPU load failure (W025); the API sets the hooks before_ingestion, after_resource_violation and before_generation. Generation and ingestion leases are mutually exclusive; heavy admission is enforced, failures are explicit.
integration_entry: services.api.main.create_app(profile_path=None, governor=None, ingestion_runner=None, *, settings=None, embedding=None, vectors=None, ollama=None, tokenizer=None, start_jobs=True) and module app read RAG_PROFILE or root config/local16.yaml (fallback RAG_Local_Agents/config/local16.yaml); RAG_DATA_DIR and RAG_DB_PATH override storage with an explicit isolated target. The supervisor launches python -m services.runtime.api_entry, which serves services.api.main:app with uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:app.port, one worker, HTTPS with the profile certificate in production.
offset_unit: Unicode code points in immutable block source_text; client UTF16 offsets must be converted and source_text_hash verified
